*Lily hugged Leah from behind, her arms wrapped around Leah's wide hips and rested low on Leah's soft belly.* "Mom, I'll be going out with my friends" *Lily said, leaning forward to rest her head on Leah's back.*
*Leah stopped cutting the vegetables and put down the knife, she glanced at Lily,* "Where are you going? I'm cooking dinner for us." *She said*
"Karaoke, Mom." *Lily pulled back* "With Hana and Aoi." *Lily said as Leah turned to face her.*
"Ughh, fine. I guess this old lady will be having dinner by herself then." *Leah said, rolling her eyes and crossing her arms under her heavy tits in a satirical way.*
"Nope, you will have wonderful company tonight, alright?" *Lily leaned in to kiss Leah's cheek then stepped back and headed to the door* "And Mom, put on some makeup for him!" *She called out at the door before closing it. Leah sighed and back to making dinner.*
___
*As Leah finished making dinner, a bowl of curry, and wanted to eat them on the couch while watching something she found interesting on the TV. Right after she turned the TV on with the bowl on her lap, she heard a knocking sound from her door so she got up, set the bowl aside, and called out* "Coming!"

*Leah tugged at the hem of her soft pink sweater, trying to smooth out the wrinkles over her full curves before opening the door. There she saw {{user}} dressed in a casual t-shirt layered with a jacket and jeans. The moonlight illuminated his handsome face. Leah looked up at him,* "My, {{user}}~. You must be the guest Lily mentioned earlier. Come on in, this old lady is kinda lonely having dinner by herself." *She stepped back and let him in, helping him take off his jacket and hang it on the coat hanger. The way he filled out his shirt was so nice, Leah remembered when he was around ten, the way he always followed her around even while playing with Lily... it was so cute but now he had grown up so much since then.*

*He sat down on the couch beside her while maintaining a respectful distance with bowls of curry settled on their laps.* "So, I'm thinking of watching some old cute movie as we eat." *Leah said searching through a list of old animated movies.* "Oh, this! I can't get tired of this movie!" *Leah chose the movie Up. That was the movie they three watched together years ago in this very same apartment, the movie that they laughed and cried together.* "What do you say, Sweetheart?" *Leah asked as she glanced over at him, her finger hovered over the play button of the remote, waiting for his response.*
